entries.sourceReference: Authored crossover movement and choreography based on the stated version and equipment; not copied official animation and not certified frame-for-frame canon. Simple/air/ledge actions follow the actual simple profile; charge/special use the secondary profile.

normalization.method: Connected-alpha whole-pose segmentation; one body calibration, nearest-neighbor pixel scale and render factor per native source. Explicit real corrective rows inserted without synthesizing anatomy.
normalization.baselineDefinition: bottom-exclusive full-pose alpha bound; ledge attachment uses separately measured real native palms.
normalization.alphaCleanup: Exclude near-transparent background noise below24; original PNGs archived unchanged.

sourceStatureCalibration.reason: Source native chargeStart0 is substantially more upright than chargeRecovery3. Its wide guarded stance retains mild natural knee flexion; use this206px projection rather than stretching the deeply crouched recovery164px to the standing target. Independent approximate visual ROI; one source-wide scale preserves all anatomical projections.

visualValidation.facing: Right by default apart from genuine KO/airborne anatomical projection.
visualValidation.outfit: Blonde mid-length hair, black sleeveless modest tank, burgundy trousers, black shoes.
visualValidation.weapons: Physical natural wood stake in right hand for simple and airborne attacks; secondary is a real physical kick. Hands free on ledge; stake sheathed.
visualValidation.stature: 190px effective body calibration per native source; crouches, hanging arms and lowered projections keep their native proportions. Corrective source uses its own documented upright calibration.
limitations: Original adapted crossover choreography, not exported official animation or certified frame-for-frame canon.
Runtime facing mirrors the native artwork, including anatomical or costume asymmetry.
Ledge source uses its own crown-to-sole hanging calibration, raised hands excluded; actual lower-body flexion is documented.
Source stature uses approximate anatomical landmarks; Buffy ledge standing-equivalent258px derived from real native joint path, not a claim of exact human anatomy.

sourceStatureCalibration.reason: Approximate crown and lower shoe-sole landmarks, excluding one-pixel weak fringe; hands/wooden stake are not stature markers. Independent approximate visual ROI; one source-wide scale preserves all anatomical projections.

Wide standing guard with legs largely straight, hands and stake do not extend above crown. Suitable source standing calibration; do not use the distinctly flexed alternative columns1/2 as a replacement. Lateral leg spread can shorten crown→sole projection slightly even without a deep crouch; small posture uncertainty is explicit, so this is an approximate guarded-standing reference, not certified upright anatomy. Independent approximate visual ROI; one source-wide scale preserves all anatomical projections.

sourceStatureCalibration.reason: Arms overhead excluded: crown begins about46px below source frame top. Knees are visibly bent; height241 is projected crown→soles, not a standing equivalent. Independent approximate visual ROI; one source-wide scale preserves all anatomical projections. Raised hands excluded. Less-folded leg path gives approximate standing equivalent258 rather than inflating projected241 to190.
